verdict.summary: The shared ceiling helper correctly treats a response at the configured limit as potentially truncated, validates malformed responses, and lets callers preserve their failure vocabulary. The migrated work-queue and deduplication call sites consistently request the shared ceilings and fail closed. The focused self-test and wiring suite exercise the boundary, under-ceiling behavior, actual runner seams, argv construction, malformed selection-alarm output, inline workflow syntax/wiring, and CI invocation; both test commands pass at the PR head. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect in the diff.
